answer: The sparrow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 216 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tide. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the shale queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 63 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
